summary: Audited commit beedd0415ebbfad8c2e2c7c2f39c99c652c40290 against the collections specification. The full test suite passed, and independent calculations confirmed the principal formulas, references, RNG restoration, and data alignment. Acceptance is blocked by a numerical-zero defect that reports an enormous variance ratio for collections containing identical specimens.

findings.claim: Constant collections receive zero variance and the corresponding no-variation explanation.
findings.problem: Floating-point centring residue produces positive variances for exactly identical coefficient rows. The text treats these residues as genuine variation and divides them, producing a meaningless ratio.
findings.evidence: The server reproduction gave within-collection row differences of exactly 0, but variances 4.5623235653455283e-66 and 2.8888949165808538e-34. The generated text reported 'a ratio of 63320693396766192788713188098048.0 to 1.' See degenerate.log.
findings.repair: Apply consistent numerical-zero handling to within-collection and leave-one-out variance, then use those values throughout summaries, corrections, and interpretation.
findings.acceptance_check: Duplicate non-integer coefficient rows and duplicate outlines must yield zero variances and leave-one-out ranges, with no ratio. Mixed constant/varying collections must select the mixed-zero explanation.

findings.claim: The geography reference uses all possible assignments whenever n_assignments <= 5040.
findings.problem: The random branch returns 999 assignments, which satisfies this condition. References for eight or more collections are therefore incorrectly described as complete enumeration.
findings.evidence: The condition is `if (geo$n_assignments <= 5040) ", all possible"`. Independent eight-collection and server nine-collection fixtures both produced '999 assignments, all possible'.
findings.repair: Return an explicit enumeration/random method field from shape_geo_correlation and use it in the interpretation.
findings.acceptance_check: Five and seven collections report complete enumeration with 120 and 5040 assignments; eight and nine report 999 random assignments in both tab and PDF text.

findings.claim: Each collection pair occupies its own row in the pair-reference plot.
findings.problem: Pasted display labels are also categorical identifiers. Distinct pairs whose names contain 'and' can collapse onto one plotted row.
findings.evidence: Names A, B and C, A and B, and C produce six pairs but five distinct plotted y positions. Both (A, B and C) and (A and B, C) become 'A and B and C'. Reproduced in numeric.log.
findings.repair: Use unique pair identifiers independently of display labels, and disambiguate names in labels.
findings.acceptance_check: The four-name fixture produces six distinct rows, each with its own correctly matched observation and reference.

findings.claim: The tests establish the section-10 acceptance requirements.
findings.problem: The pair-reference oracle is insufficient, and several required branches and outputs lack tests. These include random geography assignments, pair/geography RNG preservation, eligible rank transitions, pipeline zero-variance states, and complete report content.
findings.evidence: The pair-reference assertion is only `expect_lte(ab$reference_high, max(stats::dist(pool)))`. An audit mutation replacing every pair-reference mean and limit with zero passed every collections unit test. The rank-selector test never removes a component; the report test checks only a decrease in page count.
findings.repair: Add independent reference-value oracles and regression tests for the missing branches, state transitions, CSV contents, plot identities, and report sections/cautions. The report inventories the remaining gaps.
findings.acceptance_check: The zero-reference mutation and corresponding branch/output mutations must fail targeted tests; the corrected full suite must pass with maps installed.

findings.claim: Required standing and variance cautions remain present in supported states.
findings.problem: The standing map/sample-mean and approximate-coordinate cautions are absent from COLLECTION_CAUTIONS and depend on conditional sections. The small-sample and leave-one-out explanations also disappear when any variance is zero.
findings.evidence: The two-collection report with the map unticked contained neither geographic caution; server.log records both checks as FALSE. The variance explanation is inside `if (all(v > 0))`.
findings.repair: Include all standing cautions unconditionally and move variance precision/sensitivity explanations outside the ratio branch.
findings.acceptance_check: Check tab and PDF text with no locations, a withheld map, the map box off, and positive/mixed/all-zero variances.

findings.claim: The displayed pair table contains the outputs specified in section 5.3.
findings.problem: The table omits the signed corrected square Q, although the CSV includes it.
findings.evidence: The table constructs Raw distance, Reference, and Corrected distance columns but never includes `pr$corrected_square`.
findings.acceptance_check: A negative-Q fixture displays its negative corrected square alongside corrected distance 0 in both table and CSV.

findings.claim: With fewer than two eligible collections, the tab shows only the short explanation.
findings.problem: Only the introductory text switches state. Plot containers, table, Locations controls, and cautions remain unconditional, and multiple figure outputs repeat the explanation.
findings.evidence: The Collections UI constructs all content unconditionally; `coll_intro` alone tests `!coll_ready()`.
findings.repair: Condition the comparison content on eligibility, retaining one explanation while unavailable.
findings.acceptance_check: Browser or DOM checks show only the explanation with zero or one eligible collection and the complete comparison with two.

held: Rscript tests/testthat.R completed successfully from the repository root with maps 3.4.4 installed; no test failures or skips were reported.
Independent partition: SST 160.2222222222222, SSB 77.55555555555554, SSW 82.66666666666666, share 0.4840499306518723. The seeded share reference also matched.

Independent Q values 32.33333333333333, 29.33333333333334, and -11.66666666666667 matched the implementation. Raw distances, ordinary-data variance divisors, clipping, pair-only pooling, and reference summaries were correct.

Haversine distances matched an independent spherical-vector calculation. Five-collection correlation was 0.347822001268706, and all 120 enumerated reference values matched. The eight-collection random reference also matched independently.
References preserved present and absent RNG states, including complete enumeration, random assignments, early returns, and an intentional error inside the seed helper.
Full-data alignment, H, coefficients, and PCA feed eligible-row statistics correctly. An interleaved server fixture verified summary/download values and special-character labels.

Locations rejection conditions, text parsing, replacement, rematching, templates, and clearing match the contract. Result CSV schemas, empty missing cells, header-only unavailable output, and coordinate exclusion were verified.
Map geometry, backgrounds, scale-bar selection and placement matched independent checks. Build note (a) is correct: 1000 km along the parallel at 60 degrees spans 996.9156797055513 km by haversine.

Rank-0/1 availability, selector fallback, unmatched locations, coincident positions, and withheld maps produced figures or messages without new reactive/download errors. F1 remains an interpretation error in those states.
The map checkbox removed the map section: 24 pages with it, 23 without. Nine-level colour/fill palettes passed. The statistics performance fixture took 0.437 seconds.
not_examined: Browser layout and manual checklist C1 to C11 were not run; the checklist explicitly remains NOT YET RUN. No deployment or real collections were examined.
The author's unavailable mutation run was not used. Only the logged audit mutation was executed.
External literature, the README archival-date claim, and unbiasedness after fitted alignment/harmonic selection were not independently established.

PDF text and page counts were checked, but pages were not visually inspected. Two removed-row warnings from an auxiliary full-report run were logged but not traced; separately rendering the new degenerate collection figures did not reproduce them.

A final optional Python report-validation here-document was blocked before execution: 'zsh:1: can't create temp file for here document: operation not permitted'. It was not rerun or worked around; see environment-check.log.
questions: Who will run and record Collections checklist C1 to C11 on the test deployment after the repairs?
